description: This file contains the implementation of the ConnectionManager class for managing network and device capabilities, building connection options, and resolving TLS parameters within an Android application.

classes.name: ConnectionManager
classes.description: Manages network connection setup, device capabilities, and TLS parameters for gateway communication within the app.

methods.name: resolveTlsParamsForEndpoint
methods.description: Determines appropriate TLS parameters for a given gateway endpoint, considering stored fingerprints, manual TLS settings, and host restrictions.

methods.name: runtimeFlags
methods.description: Builds a set of runtime flags indicating device capabilities and build configuration.

methods.name: buildInvokeCommands
methods.description: Returns a list of commands advertised by the node, based on current runtime flags.

methods.name: buildCapabilities
methods.description: Returns a list of capabilities supported by the node, based on runtime flags.

methods.name: resolvedVersionName
methods.description: Computes the version name string, appending '-dev' in debug mode if not already present.

methods.name: resolveModelIdentifier
methods.description: Identifies the device model and manufacturer, if available.

methods.name: buildUserAgent
methods.description: Constructs a user agent string with app version, Android release, and SDK info.

methods.name: buildClientInfo
methods.description: Creates a GatewayClientInfo object with app and device details for the client.

methods.name: buildNodeConnectOptions
methods.description: Builds connection options for a node role, including capabilities, commands, and client info.

methods.name: buildOperatorConnectOptions
methods.description: Builds connection options for an operator role, with relevant scopes and client info.

methods.name: resolveTlsParams
methods.description: Resolves TLS parameters for a specific endpoint, using stored fingerprint info and manual TLS configuration.
